NEGROS POWER ENERGIZES 20TH SITIO IN TALISAY, MARKS 94TH UNDER SITIO ELECTRIFICATION PROGRAM
TALISAY CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL – Bringing hope and brighter opportunities to more underserved communities, Negros Electric and Power Corp. (Negros Power) continues to expand access to electricity through its Sitio Electrification Program, with the energization of four sitios in Barangay Katilingban, Talisay City.
The newly energized sitios include Magcurao, Elena, Malasaga, and Lowe, marking the 94th sitio energized since the start of the program and the 20th sitio to benefit from electrification efforts in Talisay City.
Carrying the theme, “Reaching the Unreached, Serving the Unserved,” the initiative underscores Negros Power’s commitment to bringing electricity to communities that have long been beyond the reach of reliable power services.
For residents who have waited years for this development, the arrival of electricity means more than just having lights in their homes. It represents convenience, security, and new opportunities for their families.
For 67-year-old Nimfa Bautista of Sitio Lowe, the electrification project brings a welcome change to their everyday lives.
“Dako gid nga bulig para sa amon nga may kuryente na diri. Sang una, budlay gid kay wala kami sang kasanag kag kinahanglan pa namon magpangita sang iban nga paagi para maka suga sa gab-i. Subong, mas mahapos na ang amon pangabuhi kag mas malipayon kami nga may kuryente na sa amon lugar.”
Meanwhile, 60-year-old Marie Diaz, also from Sitio Lowe, expressed her gratitude for finally having access to electricity in their community.
“Nalipay gid kami kag dako ang amon pasalamat kay natuman na gid ang amon ginahandom nga may kuryente sa amon sitio. Dako ini nga pagbag-o para sa amon, labi na sa gab-i. Mas mangin mahapos na ang amon adlaw-adlaw nga obra kag mas maayo man para sa masunod nga henerasyon.”
For Talisay City Mayor Atty. Rowena Lopez Lizares, the project reflects the importance of collaboration between the local government and the power distribution utility in bringing essential services closer to communities.
Mayor Atty. Rowena Lopez Lizares, City Mayor of Talisay:
“Access to electricity is an important foundation for community development. This milestone demonstrates what we can achieve when the local government and the private sector work together toward a common goal. We are grateful to Negros Power for extending its services to communities that have long awaited electrification. This will open more opportunities for our residents, especially in improving their quality of life and supporting the next generation.”
Meanwhile, Engr. Mervin M. Dalian, Assistant Vice President for Network Development and Operations Group of Negros Power, highlighted the significance of Talisay City in the company’s sitio electrification journey.
He recalled that Talisay City was the first area where Negros Power energized a sitio two years ago. Today, the company marks another milestone with its 20th energized sitio in the city.
Engr. Mervin M. Dalian, Assistant Vice President – Network Development and Operations Group, Negros Power:
“Talisay City holds a special place in our Sitio Electrification Program because this was the first city where we energized a sitio two years ago. Today, we are back, marking our 20th sitio energized in Talisay. This milestone reflects how far we have come, but our work does not stop here. We are planning to reach and energize all remaining sitios within our coverage area, so that more communities can benefit from electricity. Our goal is to ensure that no community is left behind as we continue reaching the unreached and serving the unserved.”
Ma. Cecilia Pe, Assistant Vice President for Customer Care and Head of Marketing of Negros Power, emphasized that the company’s Sitio Electrification Program goes beyond expanding its distribution network, as it also aims to make a meaningful difference in the lives of underserved residents.
Ma. Cecilia Pe, AVP for Customer Care and Head of Marketing, Negros Power:
“Every sitio we energize represents another community reached and another group of families given access to opportunities that electricity can bring. Reaching our 94th sitio and our 20th in Talisay City is a significant milestone for Negros Power. We remain committed to our mission of reaching the unreached and serving the unserved, ensuring that more communities can experience the benefits of reliable electricity.”
The energization of Magcurao, Elena, Malasaga, and Lowe further strengthens Negros Power’s commitment to inclusive development and its continuing efforts to bring electricity to more communities across its franchise area.
With every sitio energized, Negros Power moves closer to its vision of making electricity accessible to more households, transforming lives one community at a time.
Reaching the Unreached, Serving the Unserved.
